title: nad-lan canonical project record
description: THE source of truth for one new-construction project. Every project page, the 3D project map, and the page factory read from here. Honesty law: every non-null structured value carries a source URL (<field>_src) and, where possible, a verbatim quote in `evidence`. Unknown = null, never invented. Coordinates are only trusted when geocode_status='geocoded' with a geocode_source; model-estimated coords live in coord_estimate_unverified and MUST NOT be used on the map.

location.description: building_address is the PARCEL, never the sales office. Geocode downstream from the address; never trust model coords.

context.description: dist_to_sea_m, sea_bearing_deg, near.{park,light_rail,train,metro_planned,highway,retail_mall,hospital,schools,landmarks} — used for the honest proximity band + the 3D scene anchoring (is it near the sea? what bearing?)

building_form.description: floors, height_m, num_buildings, footprint_shape, footprint_dims_m{x,z}, main_facade_orientation_deg, podium, facade_material, balconies — drives the 3D model + facade toggle

units.description: total_units, mix, price_min/max, ppsqm_min/max, price_basis, price_date — prices from a dedicated price pass (Madlan/Yad2/gov), each with _src + date

media.description: render_urls, video_urls, brochure_pdf, floorplan_urls, site_plan_url, virtual_tour_url, gallery_page_url, external_project_site — the raw material for a rich page; each with _src

assets_3d.description: OUR generated/authored 3D + page assets (not from the developer). Populated by the factory.

glb_model.description: repo/CDN path to the building GLB

unit_hotspots.description: per-unit {id, position, normal, camera_orbit, floor, status}

content.description: REAL editorial per language. Never machine-translated-as-native. Each is a full article body used verbatim on the page.

field_sources.description: dotted-path -> source URL for every claimed field

evidence.description: verbatim quoted snippets proving structured values

ready_for_page.description: true only when geocoded + has media + has 5-lang article + no null in the page-critical set

needs.description: what's missing before a page can ship
